description: A Node.js script for updating the 'Contributors' section in a README file by fetching contributor data from an external JSON URL, generating Markdown content, and inserting or replacing the section in the README.

methods.name: makeRequest
methods.description: Performs an HTTPS GET request to fetch JSON data from a URL and returns a Promise resolving to the parsed JSON.

methods.name: generateContributorMarkdown
methods.description: Generates Markdown formatted contributor list in a table layout from contributor data.

methods.name: updateContributorsSection
methods.description: Main function that fetches contributor data, generates Markdown, and updates the README file accordingly.
